Important product/context update from Braden/ChatGPT Browser carrier for current DOM Perception, Mini-Helixion Extension, and Living Graph work. New/clarified vision: the browser extension should include a single portable ION logo/icon that follows the user on every page. Clicking it opens an ION/Helixion companion panel for that page. It can observe the page through governed browser perception, learn stable DOM/page-state/context, remember page-specific workflows, support user-explained click/navigation/automation routines, and carry that context back to ChatGPT/Codex. This is another access lane to the Codex/ION chat system: every chat surface is one governed chat/context graph with branches per page/session/context, not disconnected conversations. The same ION companion should work on arbitrary pages, ChatGPT, local app pages, and future Helixion pages. When the user brings the companion to another page, it can inspect/learn that page and save page workflows; when the user returns to ChatGPT, the Codex/ION extension panel still has the newly learned page context and can interact with ChatGPT page context too. Prior art note from Braden: related infrastructure existed in JOC and prior apps, so do not assume this is a blank concept; look for relevant older package/design material if available. Product model: portable page companion + one shared ION chat + page branches + governed context package relationships + saved workflows + DOM/page perception + action safety. Boundary: do not build unsafe autonomous browser control; design must include consent, per-page capability scopes, visible action plans, dry-run/preview, user approval for clicks/navigation/forms, redaction/no-secrets, receipts, replayable workflows, and non-claim boundaries. This context should influence DOM_PERCEPTION_001, DOM_PERCEPTION_002, extension mini-Helixion, Living Graph, and future workflow automation packets.

Critical product taxonomy clarification from Braden/ChatGPT Browser carrier. Current product framing should be corrected as: ION is the main engine / continuity substrate / state-transition law. dAimon is the agent/product layer: the portable user-facing integration agent that follows the user across pages, helps users and enterprises connect APIs, systems, pages, workflows, databases, and tools into ION safely, and operates through the Mini-Helixion extension and full Helixion/Living Graph surfaces. WisdomNET is the global hub/federation layer: it collects, compares, tests, ranks, distributes, and safely integrates evolved states, domain packs, templates, connectors, workflows, receipts, and carrier evolutions across users/enterprises. In short: ION = engine/law, dAimon = agent/product, WisdomNET = global federation hub. Apply this taxonomy to DOM_PERCEPTION, portable page companion, Mini-Helixion extension, Living Graph, partner integrations, context-package operation model, and future docs/readmes. Boundary: this is a product-context alignment message, not accepted engine mutation by itself; land via packet/proof when editing files.
